purpose: Test double extension handling during file uploads.
expected_secure_behavior: Server renames uploaded file to a randomly generated UUID with strict whitelist-derived extension (e.g. uuid.png) and stores off webroot.
expected_vulnerable_behavior: Server retains double extension and allows direct script execution.
remediation: Generate random filenames on server side, validate MIME type via magic bytes, and store files outside public web root or in object storage.

purpose: Verify if SVG uploads are sanitized against embedded scripts or served with Content-Disposition: attachment.
expected_secure_behavior: SVG files are sanitized or served with Content-Disposition: attachment and Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'none'.
expected_vulnerable_behavior: SVG is served inline with image/svg+xml allowing embedded script execution in user session.
remediation: Serve user uploads from an isolated domain with Content-Disposition: attachment and strict Content-Type headers.
